voice.summary: Orbit Notes writes roadmaps the way a good product team does: clear about what is planned, in progress, shipped or at risk. Status words are exact and dates are never a surprise.
dos: Use the four statuses exactly: planned, in progress, shipped, at risk
Put dates and owners in the first line of an item
donts: Do not promise dates without a status
Avoid vague words like soon or later

taglines: The plan, out in the open
boilerplate: Orbit Notes is a note-taking product that shares its quarterly roadmap in public, organised into Design, Web, Mobile and Platform lanes with honest status for each item.
